---
title: "Marketing Data Intelligence Report"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: cosmo
    toc: true
params:
  ctx: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 9)
ctx <- params$ctx
```

## Dataset information

- **Dataset:** `r ctx$dataset_name`
- **Analysis date:** `r ctx$generated`
- **Rows:** `r ctx$n_rows`; **Columns:** `r ctx$n_cols`
- **Data quality score:** `r if (is.na(ctx$quality_score)) "n/a" else paste0(ctx$quality_score, " / 100 (internal diagnostic, not an industry benchmark)")`

## Summary

This report was generated by Marketing Data Intelligence. It summarises the loaded
dataset, the automated KPIs, statistical tests performed during the session,
model evaluation results, forecast output, and rule-based insights. All numbers
derive from the loaded data at the time of generation.

```{r kpis, eval=!is.null(ctx$kpis), results='asis'}
kp <- data.frame(KPI = names(ctx$kpis), value = round(as.numeric(unlist(ctx$kpis)), 3))
knitr::kable(kp, caption = "KPI summary")
```

```{r stats, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(ctx$stats_results) && length(ctx$stats_results) > 0) {
  for (nm in names(ctx$stats_results)) {
    r <- ctx$stats_results[[nm]]
    cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n- Test: %s\n- p-value: %.4g\n- Effect size: %s\n",
                nm, r$test[1], r$p_value[1], r$effect_size[1]))
    if (!is.null(r$warning) && nzchar(r$warning[1] %||% "")) {
      cat(sprintf("\n> **Warning:** %s\n", r$warning[1]))
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("_No statistical analyses were run during this session._\n")
}
```

```{r models, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(ctx$model_metrics) && nrow(ctx$model_metrics) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(ctx$model_metrics, caption = "Model evaluation (held-out test data)")
  cat("\n_Model performance is an estimate on current data and may change on new data._\n")
} else {
  cat("_No machine learning models were trained during this session._\n")
}
```

```{r forecast, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(ctx$forecast_table) && nrow(ctx$forecast_table) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(ctx$forecast_table, caption = "Forecast (point estimate with 95% prediction interval; forecasts are estimates, not guarantees)")
} else {
  cat("_No forecast was produced during this session._\n")
}
```

## Insights

```{r insights, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(ctx$insights) && nrow(ctx$insights) > 0) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(ctx$insights))) {
    cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n%s\n\n", ctx$insights$title[i], ctx$insights$explanation[i]))
    if (!is.na(ctx$insights$evidence[i])) cat(sprintf("- **Evidence:** %s\n", ctx$insights$evidence[i]))
    if (!is.na(ctx$insights$action[i])) cat(sprintf("- **Recommended action:** %s\n", ctx$insights$action[i]))
    if (!is.na(ctx$insights$confidence[i])) cat(sprintf("- **Limitations:** %s\n", ctx$insights$confidence[i]))
  }
} else {
  cat("_The dataset does not contain sufficient evidence for specific insights._\n")
}
```

## Limitations

- Findings describe observed associations; they are not causal effects.
- KPI quality depends on the uploaded data; review the data quality section.
- Forecasts and models are statistical estimates with uncertainty.
